findings.title: Hamas seeks emergency talks after Israeli strike killed 3 Gaza aid workers
findings.location: Gaza Strip; request addressed to ceasefire mediators and guarantors; triggering previously reported strike in Tel al-Hawa, southwest Gaza City
findings.affected_population_system: Ceasefire mediation and humanitarian protection for displaced civilians and food-distribution workers. Hamas reportedly requested an urgent meeting of mediators and guarantors following the already documented November 21 food-vehicle strike. This does not establish that any meeting was held or accepted, or that the three dead had independently verified charity affiliations. No additional casualties counted.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Hamas requested an urgent meeting of ceasefire mediators and guarantors in the Gaza Strip
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting a statement/request attributed to Hamas

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Additional targeted source search #6 (Anadolu Nov 22 report) and full direct article read; corroboration search #7 found no distinct independent meeting confirmation
bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: Anadolu article lists 22 November 2026 as both publication and update date; no time of day available
bounded_discovery_context.comparison_to_prior: Predecessor hourly heartbeat recorded no new negotiation activity. It and earlier heartbeats already documented the November 21 Tel al-Hawa food vehicle strike, three fatalities, and the World Central Kitchen denial of affiliation. The reported new action is an urgent meeting request, not another strike or a verified resumption of negotiations.
relevant_miss_classes: military operations with documented civilian impact
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: Single named news agency report; independent corroboration and exact timing of the Hamas request absent. The source describes a requested meeting, not a completed or scheduled mediator meeting. Source's characterization of three victims as soup kitchen workers is attributed, not treated as independently established.
